# CC-CEDICT

`cedict_1_0_ts_utf-8_mdbg.txt.gz` from <https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/dictionary?page=cc-cedict>,
dated 2026-11-03. CC BY-SA 4.0 (<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/>).

Not kept here: the file is 9 MB and only its readings are used. `src/build-readings.ts` turns it
into `data/zh/readings.txt` and `data/zht/readings.txt`, which are CC BY-SA 4.0 too and are
credited in the footer of the Chinese pages.
